name: Screen & Skyline® Shades
description: Screen and Skyline® shades provide solar protection while maintaining your view, available in a range of openness factors and contemporary fabrics.

benefits.text:
Sustainable Fabrics
The fabrics in the Eco Collection feature recycled content,  
including one with recovered shoreline plastic.  
A Better View
Choose fabrics in higher openness factors (a looser weave),  
for an optimal view outside the window. 
Expansive Sizes   
Wide widths and long heights provide coverage for  
larger windows throughout any home. 
Enhanced Comfort
Fabrics are designed to reflect the sun’s rays,  
reducing glare and keeping rooms cooler. 
Benefits
UV Protection
Screen fabrics help control harsh UV rays to keep furniture,  
flooring and artwork from fading. 
Product Versatility
Create a cohesive look at the window with fabrics available  
in both Designer Screen and Skyline® Panels collections. 
BENEFITS

product_details.text:
Fabric Features
Light Colored Fabrics
Light colored fabrics provide a softer view-through, reflect light,  
helping prevent heat gain (which reduces cooling costs) and  
block UV rays, keeping furniture and flooring from fading. 
Dark Colored Fabrics 
Dark colored fabrics provide a crisp view-through, reduce glare  
and absorb light and heat, keeping a room cooler.

The absorption of light and heat, a low 
number means the shade absorbs little 
solar energy.

Screen fabrics protect your home from the sun’s

Screen Duolite® Shade Option
Screen Dual Roller Shade  
This design option pairs together two individual shades. Select between 10%, 5% or 3% for the front shade and a Dakota Semi-Opaque  
or Swinton Opaque Roller fabric for the liner. Each shade moves independently, for flexible light control and privacy.
Screen Duolite® Shade 
This design option combines a 10%, 5% or 3% fabric with a room-darkening color coordinated liner. Fully lower  
the screen fabric for soft light; if you desire more light control or privacy, simply lower the liner.

hardware_colors.text:
Skyline® Patented Hardware
Fabric Hanger
Designed for fabric stability while adding a tailored look. Unlike other  
systems, our fabric is wrapped over and attached to the hanger providing  
greater fabric stability. White only.
Headrail
The dual-channel, single track design allows for an infinite number of  
panels to be installed on a single headrail. With other standard panel track  
systems, the number of tracks expand as the number of panels increase.  
Available in 9 Custom Hardware colors.
Bottom Weight
The innovative snap-on, snap-off system ensures stability and provides  
smooth operation. Available in 9 Custom Hardware colors.
